commands.name: full-case-original-kpar
command:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, zipfile
root=Path('.')
with zipfile.ZipFile(root/'standards/artifacts/Systems-Library.kpar') as archive:
    for name in ['Allocations','AnalysisCases','Cases','UseCases','VerificationCases']:
        path=f'Systems Library/{name}.sysml'
        data=archive.read(path)
        assert data==(root/'standards/libraries/Systems-Library'/path).read_bytes()
        print(path,len(data),hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
